name: Myrkr

criminalActivity: Organized but disciplined under Karrde influence

riskAssessment: High value, low tolerance for careless traffic

name: Wayland
tradeValue: Low legitimate value; extreme strategic archive value
strategicImportance: Imperial strategic cache with consequences beyond local control.
riskAssessment: Treat all recovered information as contaminated until independently verified

militaryPresence: Heavy shipyard defenses; status reduced post-engagement
criminalActivity: Low routine access; high wartime covert interest
strategicImportance: Shipyard control determines Imperial repair tempo.

name: Coruscant
tradeValue: Extreme political and financial exchange value
strategicImportance: Control of the narrative often precedes control of the chamber.
riskAssessment: Every meeting has at least two audiences

criminalActivity: Low routine activity; high wartime infiltration incentive

name: Jomark

militaryPresence: Low conventional presence; severe Force-user risk

name: Obroa-skai

militaryPresence: Moderate defensive posture around knowledge infrastructure
criminalActivity: Low conventional crime; high data theft risk
strategicImportance: Archive-rich world where theft of context can be as damaging as theft of hardware.

name: Ukio
government: Local planetary authority under wartime pressure
militaryPresence: Low conventional strength; vulnerable to psychological attack
criminalActivity: Low routine activity; high rumor exploitation risk
strategicImportance: Demonstrated how orbital deception can convert a low-combat world into a political signal.

name: Kuat
criminalActivity: Low visible crime; high contract manipulation risk
strategicImportance: Procurement behavior can reveal factional recovery before fleets move.
riskAssessment: Do not confuse commercial neutrality with strategic neutrality

name: Corellia
government: Corellian local authority with strong independent identity
population: Dense industrial, mercantile, and shipwright population
militaryPresence: Moderate local defense and shipyard security
tradeValue: High shipping, brokerage, and engineering value
criminalActivity: Embedded in cargo culture; manageable with local contacts
strategicImportance: Corellian lanes carry both legitimate logistics and deniable access.
riskAssessment: Local pride can disrupt otherwise clean central-command assumptions

name: Kashyyyk
militaryPresence: High defensive potential; low tolerance for coercive visitors
tradeValue: Moderate legitimate trade, high refuge value
criminalActivity: Low tolerated activity; high consequences for betrayal
strategicImportance: Useful protected contact ground when New Republic formal spaces are too visible.
riskAssessment: Respect local trust chains or lose the planet as a contact surface

name: Chandrila
militaryPresence: Low symbolic target profile; elevated protective intelligence
tradeValue: Moderate economic value; high legitimacy value
strategicImportance: Symbolic pressure point against New Republic continuity and Mothma's legitimacy.
riskAssessment: Threat value is symbolic more than military
